content.hebrew: אֵיתָן, אַחַר כְּלוֹת בְּרִיתוֹ וּבְרִית כָּל־הֲמוֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: Etan, aḥar kelot berito uvrit kol hamonav,
content.english: Ethan—after the conclusion of his covenant [of circumcision], and that of all his multitudes,

content.hebrew: הָרְאָה אֵלָיו יוי בְּמַרְאוֹת חֶזְיוֹנָיו.
content.transliteration: Haroh elav Adonai bemarot ḥezyonav.
content.english: Adonai appeared to him in visions, appearances.

content.hebrew: רָחַשׁ לְבָבוֹ וְנָשָׂא עֵינָיו.
content.transliteration: Raḥash levavo venasa ‘enav.
content.english: His heart was astir, and he lifted up his eyes.

content.hebrew: נוֹדְעוּ אֵלָיו שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנָשִׁים אֱמוּנָיו;
content.transliteration: Node‘u elav shelosha anashim emunav;
content.english: He noticed three men, His faithful ones;

content.hebrew: רָץ לִקְרָאתָם בְּטוּב רַעְיוֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: Rats liḳratam betuv ra‘yonav,
content.english: He ran to greet them, with good thoughts,

content.hebrew: הִרְבָּה אֲלֵיהֶם תַּחֲנוּנָיו בְּמֵיטַב הֶגְיוֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: Hirba alehem taḥanunav bemetav heḡyonav,
content.english: He greatly entreated them, with the best of intentions.

content.hebrew: מְעַט הִזְכִּיר וְהִרְבָּה עֲדָנָיו.
content.transliteration: Me‘at hizkir vehirba ‘adanav.
content.english: He mentioned little, but had many delicacies prepared.

content.hebrew: מַטְמוּנֵי סוֹד גִּלּוּ לוֹ, וּמַצְפֻּנָיו:
content.transliteration: Matmunē sod gillu lo umatspunav:
content.english: They revealed concealed secrets to him, and esoterica:

content.hebrew: אֶחָד בִּשְּׂרוֹ כִּי יוֹלִיד בֵּן לִזְקוּנָיו,
content.transliteration: Eḥad bissero ki yolid ben lizḳunav,
content.english: One announced to him that he would sire a son in his old age,

content.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵיהֶם לְהַפֵּךְ סְדוֹם וּלְהַצִּיל לוֹט מִיַּד מַשְׂטִינָיו.
content.transliteration: Ushnehem lehappekh sedom ulhats’tsil Lot miyyad mastinav.
content.english: And two of them [went] to overturn Sodom, and rescue Lot from the hands of his enemies.

content.hebrew: אָז קָרַב אַב הָמוֹן לָדַֽעַת רָז וְעִנְיָנָיו׃
content.transliteration: Az ḳarav Av Hamon lada‘at raz ve‘inyanav:
content.english: Then the father of a multitude drew near, to know the secret and its details:

content.hebrew: ? "הַאֵין מִבְדָּל בֵּין עִקֵּשׁ לְנָבָר, בְּמִשְׁפְּטֵי אֵל וְדִינָיו
content.transliteration: “Ha’en mivdal ben ‘iḳḳesh lenavar, bemishpetē El vedinav?
content.english: “Is there no distinction between perverse and pure, in God’s judgments and rulings?

content.hebrew: וְעֵינֵי יוי הֵֽמָּה מְשׁוֹטְטוֹת, וְהַכֹּל גָּלוּי לְפָנָיו!"
content.transliteration: Ve‘enē Adonai hemma meshotetot, vehakkol galuy lefanav!”
content.english: But Adonai’s eyes scan [the world], and everything is revealed to Him!”

content.hebrew: וּמֵחֲמִשִּׁים עַד עֲשָׂרָה הָיוּ מִבְחָנָיו,
content.transliteration: Umeḥamish’shim ‘ad ‘asara hayu mivḥanav,
content.english: And [Abraham] examined if there were fifty, [even down] to ten,

content.hebrew: הֱיוֹת לְכָל־עִיר שְׁנַֽיִם מִנֶּאֱמָנָיו.
content.transliteration: Heyot lekhol ‘ir shenayim minne’emanav.
content.english: [That is, if] there were [even] two of [God’s] faithful in each city [of the five].

content.hebrew: וְלֹא נִמְצָא יְרֵא יוי, מְמַלֵּא רְצוֹנָיו.
content.transliteration: Velo nimtsa yerē Adonai, memallē retsonav.
content.english: But no one was found who feared Adonai, who fulfilled His will.

content.hebrew: אֲזַי הִשְׁחִית הַמָּקוֹם בְּכַֽעַס חֲרוֹנָיו.
content.transliteration: Azai hish’ḥit hammaḳom bekha‘as ḥaronav.
content.english: Then He destroyed the place, with His raging anger,

content.hebrew: וְשִׁלַּח לוֹט מִתּוֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָה, כִּי יָקְרָה נַפְשׁוֹ בְּעֵינָיו.
content.transliteration: Veshillaḥ Lot mittokh hahafekha, ki yaḳera nafsho be‘enav.
content.english: And sent out Lot from the midst of the upheaval, for his life was dear in His eyes.

content.hebrew: וּבְחֶשְׁקוֹ אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ אֲהוּבַת רֵֽעַ – קוֹל פְּחָדִים בְּאָזְנָיו!
content.transliteration: Uvḥeshḳo Avimelekh ahuvat re’a‘ – ḳol peḥadim be’oznav!
content.english: When Abimelech desired the beloved of [God’s] friend, there was a fearsome voice in his ears—
content.comments: The beloved of [God’s] friend. Sarah, the beloved of God’s friend Abraham.

content.hebrew: כְּמֶֽלֶךְ כְּהֵֽלֶךְ, כָּעֶֽבֶד כַּאדֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: Kemelekh kehelekh, ka‘eved kadonav,
content.english: Wayfarer and king, servant and master,

content.hebrew: יִסָּֽפוּ, אִם לֹא יָשִׁיב אֵֽשֶׁת הַנָּבִיא אֶל מְלוֹנָיו.
content.transliteration: Yissafu, im lo yashiv eshet hannavi el melonav.
content.english: Would perish, if [Abimelech] would not return the prophet’s wife to his lodgings.

content.hebrew: וַיוי פָּקַד אֶת־שָׂרָה מִמְּכוֹן מְעוֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: Va’Adonai paḳad et Sara mimmekhon me‘onav
content.english: And Adonai took note of Sarah, from the place of His [heavenly] abode,

content.hebrew: וַתֵּֽלֶד בֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר אֱלֹהִים בִּזְמַנָּיו.
content.transliteration: Vatteled ben ka’asher dibber Elohim bizmannav.
content.english: And she gave birth to a son in his [due] time, as God had said.

content.hebrew: וְהִרְחִיק אָמָה וּבְנָהּ מִמִּבְחַר פְּנִינָיו.
content.transliteration: Vehirḥiḳ ama uvnah mimmivḥar peninav.
content.english: And he distanced the handmaiden and her son from his select pearls.
content.comments: The handmaiden and her son. Hagar and Ishmael.

content.hebrew: וּבִבְנוֹ יְחִידוֹ נֻסָּה בְנִסְיוֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: Uvivno yeḥido nussa venisyonav,
content.english: And [Abraham] was tested, among his tests, with his only son—

content.hebrew: לְהַעֲלֹתוֹ אֶל הַר הַמּוֹריה יַחְשְׁבֵֽהוּ לוֹ כְּצֹאנָיו.
content.transliteration: Leha‘a lot el har hamMoriyya yaḥ’shevehu lo ketsonav.
content.english: To bring him up to Mount Moriah, and consider him like his sheep.

content.hebrew: וּמֵרֹב אַהֲבָתוֹ לְצוּרוֹ הִשְׁכִּים וְשִׁנֵּס מָתְנָיו.
content.transliteration: Umerov ahavato letsuro hishkim veshinnes motnav.
content.english: And due to his great love for his Rock, he rose early and girded his loins;

content.hebrew: וּבְבוֹאוֹ בִּמְקוֹם הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ, וּשְׁנֵי נְעָרָיו לְפָנָיו,
content.transliteration: Uv’vo’o bimḳom haḳḳodesh, ushnei ne‘arav lefanav
content.english: And when he reached the place of holiness, with his two [attending] young men before him,

content.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיבָם עִם הַחֲמוֹר, פֶּן יֵדְעוּ צְפוּנָיו.
content.transliteration: Hoshivam ‘im haḥamor, pen yed‘u tsefunav.
content.english: He had them stay with the ass, lest they know his secret [designs].

content.hebrew: וְהָאָב עִם בְּנוֹ הָלַךְ לְהַפְקִיד פִּקְדוֹנָיו;
content.transliteration: Veha’av ‘im beno halakh lehafḳid piḳdonav;
content.english: The father walked with his son, to give back his charge.

content.hebrew: עֲקָדוֹ, וְשָׂם הַמַּאֲכֶֽלֶת עַל צַוְּארוֹנָיו.
content.transliteration: ‘aḳado vesam hamma’akhelet ‘al tsavveronav.
content.english: He bound him, and placed the knife at his neck.

content.hebrew: קוֹל מִמְּרוֹמִים שָׁמְעוּ אָזְנָיו׃
content.transliteration: Ḳol mimmeromim shame‘u oznav:
content.english: His ears heard a voice from on high:

content.hebrew: "אַל תִּשְׁלַח יָדְךָ אֶל הַנַּֽעַר, כִּי עָצְמוּ שְׂשׂוֹנָיו!
content.transliteration: “Al tishlaḥ yadekha el hanna‘ar, ki ‘atsemu sesonav!
content.english: “Do not set your hand against the boy; rather, his joy has become great.

content.hebrew: זֶה עֶֽשֶׂר פְּעָמִים נִסִּיתִֽיךָ; עַתָּה יִכָּתֵב זִכְרוֹנְךָ וְזִכְרוֹנָיו."
content.transliteration: Zē ‘eser pe‘amim nissitikha; ‘atta yikkatev zikhronekha vezikhronav.”
content.english: I have tested you these ten times; now you and he will be memorialized in writing.”

content.hebrew: אַחַר כָּל־זֶה נָשָׂא אִישׁוֹנָיו,
content.transliteration: Aḥar kol zē nasa ishonav,
content.english: After all this, he lifted up his eyes,

content.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אַֽיִל אַחַר נֶאֱחַז בַּסְּבַךְ בְּקַרְנָיו;
content.transliteration: Vayar ayil aḥar ne’eḥaz bassevakh beḳarnav;
content.english: And he saw, behind, a ram, entangled in the thicket by its horns;

content.hebrew: וְתַֽחַת בְּנוֹ הֶעֶלָֽהוּ לְעֹלָה, וְחֹק זֶה הוּחַק לְבָנָיו׃
content.transliteration: Vetaḥat beno he‘elahu le‘ola, veḥoḳ zē huḥaḳ levanav:
content.english: He offered it as a burnt offering instead of his son, and this decree was inscribed for his children:

content.hebrew: זְכוּתוֹ תַּשִּׂיג לִבְנֵי בָנָיו,
content.transliteration: Zekhuto tassiḡ livnē vanav,
content.english: That his merit would reach his children’s children,

content.hebrew: וְיִבָּנֶה מִקְדַּשׁ אֵל עַל יֹֽשֶׁר אֲבָנָיו.
content.transliteration: Veyibbanē miḳdash el ‘al yosher avanav.
content.english: And God’s Temple would be built upon the stones of his righteousness.

content.hebrew: קהל: מְקוֹם אֲבָנָיו יִהְיוּ סַפִּירִים בְּבִנְיָנָיו.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Meḳom avanav yihyu sappirim bevinyanav.
content.english: Cong. May the places of his stones be of lapis lazuli when they are built.

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יו֣י צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃ (תהלים קב:יז)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki vana Adonai tsiyyon nir’a bikhvodo:
content.english: Cantor: For Adonai has built Zion, he has appeared in His Glory. (Ps. 102:17)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃ (יחזקאל ג:יב)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Barukh kevod Adonai mimmeḳomo:
content.english: Cong. Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
